analytics.trackingHint: Daily values are counted since version 1.6.0 – earlier days are empty. Older totals are available via CSV export.
analytics.zeroHint: Fix: use "Synonym" or "Redirect" to create a rule for the term right away. Terms marked ⚠ were searched often but never clicked.

rewrites.title: Stored rewrites
rewrites.hint: These terms are automatically searched as a different term – found by Claude or learned from visitor corrections. Disabling switches a rewrite off permanently; the term is then neither learned again nor sent to Claude.
rewrites.error: The rewrite could not be disabled.

rules.loadError: The list could not be loaded.
rules.cacheHint: Changes apply to new searches immediately. Cached search pages show them after clearing the cache.

synonyms.intro: Equivalent terms: searching for one also finds products containing the others. Example: brake pads, brake shoes.
synonyms.help: At least two terms, separated by commas. Case does not matter.
synonyms.importHint: CSV import: one group per line, terms separated by commas (exports of other search services work too, the terms column is detected). Duplicate groups are skipped.

redirects.intro: Searching exactly this term leads straight to the target page instead of the search results. Example: shipping → /shipping.
redirects.help: Target as shop path (/account) or full URL (https://…).
redirects.importHint: CSV import: one redirect per line as "term;target" (comma or = also work). Existing terms are skipped.

import.title: Import search data
import.intro: Imports search terms and clicks from the CSV export of a previous search service ("search terms" and "products" files – detected automatically). They take effect immediately for popular searches, learned ranking and "popular in search" and appear in the CSV export – not in the KPIs and tables on this page, because the exports contain no daily values. The same file is only imported once.

result.products: {imported} term/product clicks imported, {skipped} products not found

hints.intro: If one of the words appears in the search term, the search window shows a hint at the top – e.g. "mirror t2" → "Parts for VW are in our shop …" with a link. The search itself runs as usual.
hints.importHint: The placeholder {'{'}term{'}'} in the link is replaced by the search term – so the link leads straight to the search in the other shop.
hints.textPlaceholder: e.g. Parts for VW are in our shop example.com
hints.help: Words separated by commas; they must appear as a whole word in the search term. Link optional: shop path or https:// URL, {'{'}term{'}'} = search term.
